# Tu Gusto

Tu Gusto ("To Your Taste") is a premium coffee equipment and specialty beans store in Egypt. We offer espresso machines, coffee grinders, freshly roasted beans, and accessories — with bilingual support in English and Arabic.

## About

- **Name**: Tu Gusto — على مزاجك
- **What we sell**: Espresso machines, coffee grinders, specialty coffee beans, and brewing accessories
- **Locations**: Egypt (nationwide delivery)
- **Languages**: English (`/en`) and Arabic (`/ar`)

## Key pages

- Home: https://tugusto.com/en, https://tugusto.com/ar
- Products / shop: https://tugusto.com/en/products
- About us: https://tugusto.com/en/about
- Orders / tracking: https://tugusto.com/en/orders

## Products

- Pro Dual Boiler Machine — a professional dual boiler espresso machine
- Signature House Blend — our signature roasted coffee blend
- Ethiopian Yirgacheffe — single-origin specialty beans from Ethiopia
- Compact Burr Grinder — precision burr grinder for consistent grinding
- Stainless French Press 1L — classic 1-liter stainless steel french press
- Gift Box — Coffee Lover — curated gift box for coffee enthusiasts
